label: Undergraduate RA
heading: Undergraduate research
intro: Undergraduate research positions depend on our current projects, mentoring capacity, and funding, so openings are not guaranteed. If you are interested, email Xinning Gui or Yubo Kou and include:
steps: Which of our research areas or projects interests you, and why.
Relevant experience, such as coursework, research, design, programming, or social science methods.
Whether you are looking for a funded research assistant position or a volunteer role.
How many hours per week you can contribute, and in which semesters.
